claims.statement: After the death of his uncle Francesco, Leonardo's half brothers contest the will. Leonardo returns to Florence for the suit.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Legal records of the dispute.
